Pose - Crouching Ready.description:
🕴️ Pose: Crouching Ready
Low to the ground in a ready crouch — prepared to spring, dodge, or react at a moment's notice.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Crouching Ready.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, lower the center of gravity into a compact ready posture with bent visible joints, torso angled forward, and frame-visible hands held near guard position. Do not force lower-body visibility outside the crop. Female: knees close, shoulders drawn in over the crouch. Male: knees apart, shoulders set heavy over the crouch. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own crouch.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
